Enzyme kinetics

  • Michaelis–Menten: v = Vmax·[S] / (Km + [S])
  • Km: substrate concentration at ½ Vmax
  • Competitive inhibition raises the apparent Km

Hypothesis testing

H₀: μ₁ = μ₂ against H₁: μ₁ ≠ μ₂

Reject H₀ when p ≤ α = 0.05

Sensitivity = TP / (TP + FN)

Summary

  • Kinetics → rates and affinity
  • Statistics → evidence against H₀
  • Accuracy → sensitivity and specificity
